mapper.sql: select c.company_id, c.company_name, c.dept_id, c.contact_name, c.contact_phone, c.scale, c.address, c.owner_user_id, c.status, c.expire_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.remark, (select count(1) from sys_user u where u.company_id = c.company_id and u.del_flag = '0') as member_count from tz_company c
mapper.select: where c.company_id = (select u.company_id from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId})

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.phonenumber as phonenumber, u.company_id as companyId, u.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, u.create_time as joinTime, (select group_concat(r.role_name) from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id) as roles from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where u.company_id = #{companyId} and u.del_flag = '0' order by u.user_id
mapper.update: update sys_user set company_id = null, dept_id = null where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set dept_id = #{deptId} where user_id = #{userId} and company_id = #{companyId}
